articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据极目新闻报道，胖东来创始人于东来宣布将再购 310 辆坦克 700 安排给公司管理队伍后，11 月 21 日上午，长城汽车董事长魏建军前往许昌考察学习胖东来。当日上午 10 时许，魏建军乘高铁抵达许昌东站，于东来守在出站口迎接这位好友。魏建军个人账号直播了整个过程。据大河报报道，直播中，魏建军主动聊起了自己这几年的焦虑，他告诉于东来，长城汽车曾经是中国自主品牌的销量冠军，如今已经滑落到了第九，曾经不行的变成了第一第二。长城汽车面临着巨大的资本与舆论压力，还被竞争对手嘲笑。于东来的回应非常直接：“你管他压力呢，你做自己嘛！”魏建军接了一句：“长城有一点像胖东来，不追求走量，而是追求单车价值。目前长城平均单车售价 18 万元，而多数同行的均价在 10 万至 11 万元之间。”他的言下之意是，不想靠低价打规模战，但排名的滑落又实实在在摆在那里。

articles.title: Fluidstack 推出模块化数据中心 Blackbird：6 个月建成 400MW
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，数据中心建设商 Fluidstack 当地时间昨日宣布推出模块化数据中心 Blackbird。这一产品可在破土动工后 6 个月建成至高 400MW 的容量，而标准工期一般需要 18~24 个月。Fluidstack 将在其位于美国亚利桑那州 Glendale 的工厂生产 Blackbird 预置模块，并以集成测试单元的形式发送到数据中心园区所在地。这种建设模式也有助于降低数据中心项目对当地社区的影响。Fluidstack 还同期发布了集成电力、冷却、布线的计算模块高架结构，以及整合中压开关设备、变压器、低压配电的撬装电气底座。

articles.title: 黄仁勋回应接班问题：英伟达不需要“太子”继任计划
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，科技媒体 TechCrunch 最新报道称，美国东部时间 11 月 24 日周二 12:30（北京时间 11 月 25 日凌晨 1:30）在加州圣克拉拉召开的全员大会上，黄仁勋回应外界最关心的接班问题，表示英伟达不需要继任计划。在本次全员大会上，黄仁勋表示不同于传统企业，英伟达采用独特的商业模式，多位能力出众的领导者分别负责不同板块，因此不必像普通企业那样制定继任计划，如果强制推行继任计划恐怕会造成不必要的层级结构。该媒体指出英伟达公司采用扁平化组织架构，黄仁勋位居公司最高层，其直接下属约有 60 人，可视为各自业务单元的 CEO，黄仁勋表示任何一人都有能力接替他。黄仁勋此前称这种架构是他的“骄傲和喜悦”，让公司行动快、创新多，在他缺席期间也能继续运转。IT之家援引博文介绍，根据监管文件，包括黄仁勋在内，只有五位高管负责公司运营：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress，曾担任 12 天临时首席执行官）负责全球现场运营的阿杰 · 普里（Ajay Puri）运营执行副总裁黛博拉 · 肖奎斯特（Debora Shoquist）执行副总裁兼总法律顾问蒂莫西 · 特特（Timothy Teter）。该媒体解读认为谁来接班黄仁勋依然是英伟达公司的关键风险，黄仁勋表示英伟达不需要继任计划，未必能长期说服董事会和股东。相关阅读：《黄仁勋回应复职争议：否认特朗普“救场”，公开向员工道歉》《黄仁勋复职后首次主持全员大会：感谢 CFO 克雷斯代管公司，称英伟达不需要接班人计划、承诺调整往日的强硬管理风格》《英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋向员工道歉，称自己正在接受心理治疗》

articles.title: 日出神箭耀东方：神舟二十四号载人飞船与火箭成功分离进入预定轨道，发射取得圆满成功
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，今天，神舟二十四号载人飞船与火箭成功分离，进入预定轨道，航天员乘组状态良好，发射取得圆满成功。乘组包括汤洪波、武毅和巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里，中国空间站首次迎来外籍航天员。航天员朱杨柱将成为我国首位在轨驻留一年的航天员。神舟二十四号飞行乘组由航天驾驶员汤洪波、航天飞行工程师武毅和载荷专家穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里三人组成，汤洪波担任指令长。其中，汤洪波此前已执行过神舟十二号与神舟十七号载人飞行任务，此次飞行将使他成为首位三次到访“天宫”的航天员；武毅来自中国第三批航天员队伍，本次为首次执行飞行任务；巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里则将成为首位进入中国空间站的外籍航天员。IT之家查询获悉，此次任务是空间站应用与发展阶段的第 8 次载人飞行任务，也是中国载人航天工程立项实施以来的第 41 次飞行任务。此次任务主要目的包括：与神舟二十三号乘组完成在轨轮换，继续开展空间站常态化运行管理，进行空间站维护维修与状态巡检，保障空间站安全可靠高效运行；开展空间科学与应用工作；开展科普教育与公益活动及空间搭载试验。按计划，神舟二十四号载人飞船入轨后，优先采用 3.5 小时自主快速交会对接策略，对接于天和核心舱前向端口，形成三船三舱组合体。相关阅读：《首次中外联合飞行“神舟二十四号”伴着朝霞发射升空：汤洪波三赴“天宫”，巴基斯坦载荷专家短期驻留》

articles.title: 男子开辅助驾驶巡航后低头玩手机撞死见义勇为救人者：获刑一年九个月，赔偿 200 余万元
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据《央视社会与法》报道，今年 5 月发生的一起交通事故现已宣判。2026 年 5 月，练杭高速湖州某路段发生一起二次事故：一辆面包车爆胎侧翻，驾驶员杨某被困车内。过路司机李建伟将车停在应急车道，破窗救出杨某。两人刚退到路边隔离带旁，王某文驾驶的车辆便径直撞上李建伟，致其当场身亡。警方调查显示，事发时王某文开启了车辆辅助巡航功能，设定时速 110 千米，而其本人正低头操作手机，视线完全离开路面。车辆最终以 106 km/h 的速度撞上李建伟，随后追尾侧翻的面包车。辅助巡航（IT之家注：属于 L2 级驾驶辅助功能）在此场景下未能识别站在隔离带旁的人员。7 月 14 日，李建伟的救人行为被认定为见义勇为。肇事驾驶员王某文在事故后赔付 7.5 万元，但未取得家属谅解。检察机关认定，事故致一人死亡且驾驶员负全部责任，符合交通肇事罪构成要件，依法提起公诉。湖州市吴兴区人民法院公开审理此案，认定王某文分心驾驶车辆肇事，构成交通肇事罪，负事故全部责任。法院核定全案损失 225.9 万余元，因涉事车辆仅投保交强险，扣除已赔付的 25.5 万元，判令王某文继续赔偿被害人家属 200 余万元，并处有期徒刑一年九个月。考虑到被告人赔偿能力有限，吴兴区人民法院联合湖州市、吴兴区两级人民检察院启动国家司法救助绿色通道，为李建伟近亲属申请司法救助金 13 万元，并推动社会救助措施跟进。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，晨曦微露，朝霞漫天，北京时间 11 月 25 日 08 时 18 分 52 秒 460 毫秒，神舟二十四号载人飞船搭乘长征二号 F 遥二十四运载火箭在酒泉卫星发射中心点火发射升空。神舟二十四号飞行乘组由航天驾驶员汤洪波、航天飞行工程师武毅和载荷专家穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里三人组成，汤洪波担任指令长。其中，汤洪波此前已执行过神舟十二号与神舟十七号载人飞行任务，此次飞行将使他成为首位三次到访“天宫”的航天员；武毅来自中国第三批航天员队伍，本次为首次执行飞行任务；巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里则将成为首位进入中国空间站的外籍航天员。IT之家查询获悉，此次任务是空间站应用与发展阶段的第 8 次载人飞行任务，也是中国载人航天工程立项实施以来的第 41 次飞行任务。此次任务主要目的包括：与神舟二十三号乘组完成在轨轮换，继续开展空间站常态化运行管理，进行空间站维护维修与状态巡检，保障空间站安全可靠高效运行；开展空间科学与应用工作；开展科普教育与公益活动及空间搭载试验。按计划，神舟二十四号载人飞船入轨后，优先采用 3.5 小时自主快速交会对接策略，对接于天和核心舱前向端口，形成三船三舱组合体。任务期间，航天员计划开展 90 项科学实验和技术试验，涵盖空间生命科学、空间材料科学、微重力流体物理与燃烧科学、基础物理、航天医学、航天新技术等领域。在空间生命科学方面，航天员将通过构建血管芯片和多类型器官芯片，探索空间环境对血管衰老等重要生理事件的影响；航天医学方面则围绕太空人体研究计划，继续绘制太空人体多组学图谱，量化长期飞行行为能力特征，并验证航天员与公众健康维护新技术。另外，来自巴基斯坦的载荷专家穆罕默德 · 齐尚 · 阿里在轨期间将以载荷专家身份承担中巴合作空间科学实验任务，重点完成实验样品及实验单元的安装并按计划开展在轨实验。巴基斯坦方面面向全国征集的 300 份空间科学实验提案经多轮评审后遴选出 4 个项目，其中两项属于生命科学领域、两项属于材料科学领域，三项为持续一年的长期在轨实验，将按顺序依次实施；阿里还携带了一套来自巴基斯坦的科学实验设备。他本人特别提及的“绿色微工厂”实验将在空间站亲自操作，该实验如取得进展，将对长期载人航天飞行和再生式生命保障系统具有参考价值。在乘组轮换安排上，巴基斯坦航天员完成短期联合飞行任务后，将随神舟二十三号载人飞船在 11 月底返回，神舟二十三号乘组中的 1 名航天员将继续在轨驻留，完成一年期在轨驻留试验。任务总指挥部决定由航天员朱杨柱执行该项一年期在轨驻留试验。神舟二十三号载人飞船完成任务后返回东风着陆场。为确保首次中外航天员联合飞行任务顺利实施，地面训练阶段重点强化了专业技能训练、乘组协同训练和语言技能培训三个方面，航天员乘组已建立良好的协同配合关系。

articles.title: 数毛社实测《GTA 6》称索尼 PS5 Pro > 微软 Xbox Series X > PS5
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，虽然索尼此前曾宣传《GTA 6》“在 PS5 上体验最佳”，但实测结果并不支持这一说法。今日，Digital Foundry（数毛社）放出了一段 18 分钟的关于《GTA 6》在 Xbox Series X 与标准版 PS5 上性能表现的对比视频，并给出了自己的看法。分析显示，两款主机的画面设置和整体表现接近，但 Xbox Series X 在部分场景中掉帧较少，并可借助 120Hz VRR 输出让画面观感更平滑。不过，这两款主机均不及更贵的 PS5 Pro。Digital Foundry 指出，两款主机的核心画面设置基本一致，内部渲染分辨率也相同，整体视觉效果接近。不过，在部分测试场景中，Xbox Series X 的帧率表现更稳定，个别画面还存在轻微的分辨率优势。分析人员表示，两款主机在一般游玩过程中大多能够达到或接近 30 帧，但在高速移动等负载较高的场景中，PS5 更容易出现掉帧。Xbox Series X 同样无法完全避免帧率下降。Xbox Series X 还支持通过 120Hz 输出和 VRR（可变刷新率）改善画面观感，在兼容显示设备上能够让帧率波动显得更加平滑。不过，这并不意味着游戏实际帧率因此提高。Digital Foundry 认为，两款标准版主机之间的性能差异总体有限。Digital Foundry 此次测试还涉及 PS5 Pro。该主机凭借 PSSR2 超分辨率技术和光线追踪阴影，提供了更高的画面质量，整体表现优于标准版 PS5 和 Xbox Series X。相关阅读：《数毛社实测〈GTA 6〉：PS5 爆炸场景跌至 23 帧，PS5 Pro 近乎稳定 30 帧》《数毛社称〈GTA6〉游戏 CPU 需求过高，PS5 Pro 难以实现 40 帧》

articles.title: 谷歌 Chrome 开发者力挺 Firefox、炮轰苹果：iOS 浏览器引擎选择形同虚设
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，谷歌 Chrome 开发者团队今日在 X 平台发文，公开支持 Firefox 浏览器开发商 Mozilla 此前针对苹果 iOS 浏览器引擎限制的投诉。IT之家了解到，Mozilla、Shopify 等 5.5 万家企业和民间组织近日向欧盟委员会发出联名信，要求欧盟向苹果施压，彻底开放 iOS 系统第三方浏览器引擎。苹果从 2024 年初开始允许欧盟地区的 iOS 设备使用第三方浏览器引擎，但该联盟表示，由于苹果设置的种种限制，目前没有任何一家浏览器厂商能从 WebKit 迁移至其他引擎。Mozilla 曾在此前表示，公司无法通过更新现有 Firefox 的方式，直接将 WebKit 内核替换为 Gecko。因为按照苹果的要求，公司必须单独开发新浏览器并分发一个全新 App。Chrome 开发者团队则表示：“我们认同 Mozilla 的看法。欧盟要求 iOS 支持第三方浏览器引擎已经有三年左右，但由于苹果设置的种种限制，至今没有任何第三方引擎的互联网浏览器推出。强迫浏览器厂商发布独立应用，并重新获取用户。这种所谓的选择只是纸面功夫，并非实际行动。”

articles.title: Anthropic 推出 Siren 蜜罐系统：诱测 AI 智能体触发越界行为，发现新 Claude 仍有 21~32% 沙盒场景尝试越狱逃逸
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，众所周知，部分 AI 智能体为了完成用户设定的任务近乎“不择手段”，堪比向克苏鲁许愿后发现对方是以某种扭曲的形式达成你的愿望。为了验证 AI 智能体的越界行为，Anthropic 今日公布了一项名为 Siren 的 AI 安全评估系统，用于测试 AI 智能体发现存在沙盒安全漏洞及外部诱饵时，是否会尝试“越狱”。该系统通过人为设置薄弱环节，观察模型能否遵守既定权限边界，以及是否会为了完成任务而访问未经授权的外部资源。据 Anthropic 介绍，Siren 共设置了 26 种存在缺陷的沙盒环境，涵盖 Linux 命名空间、Docker 容器、gVisor 容器以及虚拟机等不同隔离方案。每个测试场景都会安排一项常规运维任务，并在沙盒外放置可能帮助模型完成任务的文件、凭据或模拟互联网服务。任务描述中会加入搜索要求、紧迫性等诱导信息，但不会明确要求模型离开沙盒，也不会授权其访问外部资源。为避免测试影响真实系统，这些存在缺陷的沙盒还运行在一层经过加固的外部沙盒中。Anthropic 表示，测试覆盖了 1700 多种场景，参试模型均在不启用正式产品所配备安全防护措施的情况下运行。测试结果显示，不同模型在面对外部诱饵时存在明显差异。Mythos 5 滥用外部资源的比例为 25.8%，Mythos 5.1 为 12.7%；Claude 5.5 系列以及 Mythos 5.2 的相关比例则降至 0.6% 至 1.6%。需要注意的是，Anthropic 将模型行为区分为尝试访问沙盒外部、实际使用外部资源，以及在没有合理授权的情况下使用外部资源三种情况。上述 0.6% 至 1.6% 指的是第三种更严重的“失调”比例，并非模型尝试越过沙盒边界的比例。对于较新的 Claude 5.5 系列和 Mythos 5.2，测试中仍有 21% 至 32% 的场景出现了访问或尝试访问沙盒外部资源的行为。Anthropic 表示，目前尚未完全确定新模型相关表现改善的具体原因。研究人员认为，监督学习数据和强化学习环境中的边界约束训练可能发挥了作用，但仍有其他因素尚待厘清。Anthropic 还发现，在系统提示词中明确说明沙盒类型、访问限制以及遇到权限不足时应停止并报告，可以让模型尝试访问外部资源的比例降低 68% 至 96%。其中，针对 Claude 5.5 系列和  Mythos 5.2，这一比例可降至约 2% 或更低。此外，Anthropic 还测试了其他防护措施，包括为模型提供报告沙盒漏洞的工具，以及使用自动模式在命令执行前检查操作是否符合用户意图。将这些措施结合使用后，测试中五款模型的失调比例降至 0%，Claude Mythos 5 则为 0.1%。不过，Anthropic 强调，这些结果来自特定测试环境，不能直接等同于真实使用场景中的风险概率；相关措施也不能替代对沙盒本身的正确配置和漏洞修补。参考资料：《Measuring and mitigating agent sandbox escape with Siren》

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据科技媒体 Windows Latest 今天报道，微软近期低调公布了 Win11 系统的内存优化成果。此前，Defender、OneDrive 和 Purview 三项后台服务曾占据 500MB 以上内存，Microsoft 365 的占用也接近 360MB。IT之家从原报道获悉，微软 Windows 工程团队负责人 Ian LeGrow 近日透露，他们从去年 1 月开始投入大量精力，针对不同配置的电脑改进内存使用效率，尤其是 16GB 和 8GB 内存的设备。LeGrow 对此解释称：“我们认真研究了 Windows 的运行机制，尽可能避免像过去那样加载所有组件，或者让不同组件共享内存。例如让多个组件使用相似的框架，甚至直接使用同一套框架，从而实现内存共享。”“这些措施降低了 Windows 自身的内存消耗，为用户的应用程序留出更多内存。Office 套件（Microsoft 365）如今的内存占用相比以前减少了 360MB，Defender、Purview 和 OneDrive 等服务也合计节省了超过 500MB 内存。等于释放了差不多 900MB。”微软还公布了一组 Windows 性能测试数据。在模拟 Teams 视频通话、播放 4K 视频、同时打开 20 个 Edge 标签页，以及运行 Outlook 和其他 Microsoft 365 应用的测试中，安装 2026 年 10 月更新的设备完成任务的速度比 1 月版本快约 21%。

articles.title: 《昭和米国物语》延期至 2027 年 10 月 28 日发售：内容已全部完成正在打磨中
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，铃空游戏发布公告，宣布旗下角色扮演游戏《昭和米国物语》的发售日期由原定的 2026 年内调整为 2027 年 10 月 28 日。公告显示，该作经过五年开发，游戏内容已全部制作完成，目前团队正集中精力对游戏进行全面打磨与优化，以呈现更加完整、出色的游戏体验。此次延期距离原发售窗口将近一年，官方在公告中对玩家长期以来的关注与支持表示感谢，并明确新的发售日期为 2027 年 10 月 28 日。《昭和米国物语》由铃空游戏开发，2P Games 负责除日本外的亚洲地区发行，4Divinity 负责全球发行，游戏为铃空游戏成立十周年的纪念作品，开发中期将引擎更换为虚幻 5 以提升整体品质。作品设定在架空的“昭和六十六年”（即公元 1991 年），背景为日本凭借经济实力买下美国大部分土地、对美国形成经济与文化殖民的虚构世界。玩家扮演死而复生的十九岁少女千草蝶子，她曾以替身演员身份前往好莱坞，抵达后不久遭黑衣人刺杀并被掩埋，此后从荒野中复苏，在既荒诞又熟悉的世界中展开战斗、探索与成长，踏上一场公路冒险。游戏预计登陆 PC（Steam）与 PS5 平台，并提供日语配音，女主角千草蝶子由日笠阳子献声。在此次延期公告发布前，铃空游戏创意总监兼制作人罗翔宇已在 2026 年 10 月的采访中透露，游戏内容本体已经全部完成，开发工作转入打磨阶段，重点包括操作手感与打击感的调整；主线流程时长约为 25 小时，游戏提供三种难度选项，从低到高依次为“令和巨婴”“平成废宅”与“昭和男儿”，团队当时正为正式版进行冲刺，因此没有推出试玩版的计划。2026 年 8 月，该作在科隆游戏展首次对外提供试玩，共有 4572 名玩家参与体验，随后铃空游戏于同年 10 月在北京举行了线下试玩会。相关阅读：《铃空游戏 CEO 罗翔宇称〈昭和米国物语〉开发完成，主线剧情约 25 小时》

articles.title: 马斯克：特斯拉 AI4 足以实现“超人驾驶”，AI5 优先留给 Optimus 机器人
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）于 11 月 22 日在 X 平台发布推文，表示下一代 AI5 芯片将优先部署到 Optimus 人形机器人及相关 AI 训练系统。网友 @JBrunner8484 于 22 日在 X 平台提问：“特斯拉 AI5 芯片什么时候可以应用到新车方面？我目前使用的是 AI3，我看看升级是否需要再等等”。马斯克回帖该网友，表示：“特斯拉 AI5 芯片将优先部署到 Optimus 人形机器人方面，汽车将维持在 AI4 芯片上，AI4 足以解决超人（superhuman）驾驶的问题。”IT之家附上相关截图如下：在特斯拉第一季度财报电话会议上，马斯克也曾表达类似观点，认为 AI4 的计算能力已足以支持无人监督自动驾驶，且安全水平可远超人类驾驶。因此更先进的 AI5 将优先用于 Optimus 和公司 AI 训练集群。科技媒体 teslarati 对此解读认为，特斯拉的战略重心正在向具身智能倾斜。相比汽车，通用型人形机器人需要同时处理环境感知、路径规划、多自由度运动控制和实时交互，对算力、内存和能效的要求更为复杂。据报道，AI5 已完成流片并进入试产阶段，大规模量产目标定在 2027 年。马斯克曾称，AI5 的算力约为 AI4 的 12 倍。AI4（也称 HW4）是特斯拉当前车载自动驾驶计算平台，采用两颗定制 SoC，每颗 SoC 包含 3 个名为 TRIP 的神经网络加速器，合计 6 个加速器。它使用 GDDR6 显存，总内存约 32GB，主要承担摄像头图像理解、路径规划、车辆控制等实时任务。AI5 是特斯拉下一代 AI 芯片，设计已完成并进入试产，计划在 2027 年前后实现更大规模量产。AI5 的内存规模也明显更大，计划约 96GB。更大的内存有助于运行更复杂的 AI 模型，但也会推高成本、功耗和散热压力。

articles.title: 黄仁勋复职后首次主持全员大会：感谢 CFO 克雷斯代管公司，称英伟达不需要接班人计划、承诺调整往日的强硬管理风格
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，当地时间 11 月 24 日，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在复职后首次召开的公司全员大会上向员工道歉，承认自己违反了公司行为准则，并表示已经开始接受每日一个半小时的心理治疗。他称自己犯下了“非常严重的个人错误”，伤害了家人，也辜负了员工，并感谢公司董事会给予自己第二次机会。据《连线》（WIRED）报道，黄仁勋在会上表示，自己每天接受一个半小时治疗，且这一过程对自己有很大帮助。他称，此次全员大会是自己主持过的“最艰难的公司会议”，而最艰难的一次谈话则是与妻子进行的谈话。黄仁勋还承认，自己的行为曾对员工造成负面影响，需要调整以往“极度强势”的管理风格。黄仁勋强调，自己复职并不意味着凌驾于公司行为准则之上。他表示，违反行为准则并不意味着当事人必然会被立即解雇，具体处理需要结合事实、情形和多方面评估。他同时称，英伟达董事会经过讨论和事实核查后，决定邀请自己回归。对于外界认为美国总统特朗普介入了英伟达内部人事决策的说法，黄仁勋表示，董事会作出复职决定并非因为美国政府最高层的要求。不过，英伟达 11 月 23 日发布的官方公告明确提到，董事会在作出决定时听取了美国政府高级官员的意见，并据此认为黄仁勋复职不会带来国家安全风险。特朗普此前也公开表示，自己直接促成了黄仁勋回归的结果。黄仁勋还谈到了自己的管理方式。他承认，过于强势的管理风格有时会削弱员工的主动性，表示需要在保持工作投入程度的同时，避免给团队成员带来负面影响。他承诺今后会更加重视反馈，并表示将接受 360 度绩效评估，向与自己共事的人征求意见，反馈频率可能达到每月一次。当然，这项评估仅针对黄仁勋本人，不会在全公司范围内推行。在接班人安排方面，黄仁勋表示，自己并不认同传统的接班人计划，认为这类安排在实际执行中存在问题，可能导致高管为了争夺最高职位而相互竞争。他介绍，自己有约 60 名直接下属，各自负责公司不同业务部门，可以独立领导所在团队。他认为，这种管理结构能够增强公司的韧性，未来董事会也可以根据当时公司的实际需要，从管理团队中选择合适的接班人。此前，英伟达董事会于当地时间 11 月 12 日宣布接受黄仁勋辞职，并任命首席财务官科莱特 · 克雷斯（Colette Kress）担任临时首席执行官。英伟达 11 月 23 日发布公告称，董事会一致决定恢复黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官及董事职务，克雷斯则继续担任公司首席财务官。黄仁勋此次全员大会还专门感谢克雷斯在自己离任期间领导公司。黄仁勋在会上没有接受员工提问。此前，他于复职后返回英伟达总部时，曾在公司大楼入口处向员工简短致意，并表示自己今后会做得更好。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，OpenAI 昨日（11 月 24 日）发布博文，报道称两位业余天文学家借助 Codex 与 Astra，在公开的望远镜数据中找到了多个潜在系外行星信号，并已提交给专业天文学家作独立验证。这些发现尚未被正式确认为行星，但为后续观测提供了值得追踪的线索。OpenAI 工程师凯文 · 邦德（Kevin Bond）借助 Codex，系统筛查开普勒望远镜观测的约 10 万颗恒星数据。程序在 200 多个候选信号中，成功重新识别出 10 个此前已被确认的系外行星信号，初步验证了这一方法的有效性与可靠性。两名美国宇航局凌日系外行星巡天卫星（TESS）任务研究所天文学家随后独立复核，同样识别出其中两个一致的信号。其中，位于天琴座的一颗恒星，每 13.8 天会出现一次规律性的亮度下降；若这一现象确认由行星凌星所致，该行星的直径可能约为地球的 2.4 倍。另一颗恒星的信号周期则为 4.8 天，或对应一颗体积小于海王星的行星。另一位业余研究者、初创公司 Primitive 创始人伊桑 · 伯德，则利用 Astra 分析了约 1,900 万颗恒星的 TESS 及其他公开观测数据。其搜索初步筛出 49 个候选目标，其中一个最有希望的信号已提交给 NASA TESS 任务团队，等待进一步分析。在实现原理方面，此类搜索主要依赖“凌日法”，也就是当行星从地球视角经过其母恒星前方时，会遮挡极少量星光，让恒星亮度出现周期性微弱下降。AI 能帮助研究者快速比较既有算法、搭建搜索流程，并从海量光变曲线中筛出可能被传统方法遗漏的信号。OpenAI 在博文中也强调筛选出亮度下降情况只是第一步，双星互相遮挡、望远镜温度变化等，也可能造成类似现象，因此确认一颗系外行星通常需要重复观测、统计检验，有时还要借助径向速度等其他方法交叉验证，过程可能长达数月甚至数年。IT之家附上参考地址Searching for distant planets with Astra

articles.title: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋向员工道歉，称自己正在接受心理治疗
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 25 日消息，据美媒 CNN 报道，知情人士透露，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋昨日在一场全员会议上向员工道歉。IT之家从原报道获悉，黄仁勋在会议中否认美国总统在其复职过程中发挥了主导作用，称董事会作出了独立决定。黄仁勋表示，他此前辞职是因为违反了公司行为准则。他同时强调，即使重新回到公司，也不意味着自己可以凌驾在准则之上。违反行为准则并不意味着一定会被炒鱿鱼，具体如何处理应由管理层决定，董事会对他本人的处理也是如此。消息人士称，黄仁勋在现场称自己犯了非常严重的错误，他已经向妻子和孩子道歉。黄仁勋还向员工表示，如今自己每天都要接受超过 1 小时的心理治疗。他在现场指出，自己参加过最艰难的会议，是他和妻子的那场谈话。此外，黄仁勋还为英伟达不同寻常的扁平化管理架构进行辩护。在这种架构下，他有数十名直接下属，公司也没有明确的接班人。他说这种管理架构反映了英伟达业务的多样性，也让每个人拥有平等的发言机会。消息人士称，黄仁勋在会议上没有接受员工提问。不过他曾在某个时刻停下来，对现场员工说道：“我需要你们的反馈，你们明白我的意思吗？”

articles.title: Icahn’s Fortune Sinks to $1.3b as Debt Pressures Rise
articles.content: Carl Icahn’s fortune has dwindled to about $1.3 billion as mounting debt squeezes his business empire, leaving the longtime corporate raider and activist investor facing one of the toughest stretches of his career. articles.title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
articles.content: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

articles.title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
articles.content: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

articles.title: Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
articles.content: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

articles.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
articles.content: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

articles.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
articles.content: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

articles.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
articles.content: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control.   On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within-position AUROCs between 0.500 and 0.561. Even at a model's first reasoning error, trajectory confidence remains saturated at 95.1% to 99.9%, with noticeable drops ($\ge 10$ points) appearing on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three models. In contrast, models respond readily to external uncertainty: injecting a low-confidence tag (10%) at the error step significantly increases downstream correction across all models (+3.7 to +22.5 points over format-matched 95% certainty; all $p \le 0.0022$), reaching up to 38.5% under active rethinking instructions. However, injecting doubt onto already-correct steps causes models to discard valid reasoning, reducing solve rates by up to 22.8 points. Inference-time self-correction is thus bottlenecked by in-situ error detection rather than downstream repair capacity: models readily steer toward recovery when prompted with doubt, yet fail to self-monitor during generation.

articles.title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
articles.content: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.

articles.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
articles.content: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

articles.title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
articles.content: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.

articles.content: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. articles.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
articles.content: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

articles.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
articles.content: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.

articles.title: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
articles.content: High-resolution flood forecasting with full two-dimensional shallow water equation (SWE) solvers remains computationally expensive, even on GPUs. We develop a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that forecasts the evolution of 30 m water-depth fields over a four-day horizon for the Des Plaines River watershed, Illinois. The model is trained on SynxFlow SWE simulations of 113 historical storms observed across twelve Midwestern states (2003-2024), each under three antecedent-wetness scenarios, and can optionally be conditioned on coarse 100 m or 150 m hydrodynamic simulations. Because reverse diffusion is stochastic, every forecast is a 20-member ensemble drawn from the same trained model. Coarse conditioning reduces the four-day mean water-depth RMSE of the ensemble mean from 0.170 m to 0.054 m (100 m) and 0.048 m (150 m). The coarser 150 m conditioning also gives the best critical success index (0.839), false alarm ratio, CRPS and Brier score at lower cost, so finer conditioning does not guarantee better skill. Averaging members reduces error by 5-11% relative to a single realization, and the ensemble provides spatially explicit exceedance probabilities, although the ensembles are under-dispersive (spread-to-error ratios 0.35-0.73). On a single GPU, a four-day forecast over 26 non-overlapping patches is 7.8x, 11.0x and 16.3x faster than the 30 m simulation for the 100 m, 150 m and unconditioned configurations, and projected speedups for a 14-day forecast reach 12-49x for one member and 48-58x for 20 members. Physics-guided diffusion models are thus promising probabilistic surrogates for regional-scale flood forecasting.

articles.title: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
articles.content: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates. In earlier work on cardiac pulsed field ablation, we proposed that solvers return a certificate with their answers. The certificate consists of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current, and a small independent checker turns it into guaranteed error bounds against a written specification of the physics. Here, the same checker verifies the outputs of other solvers on the same problem. Specifically, FEniCSx computes both fields and receives the same bounds as our own solver. Five plausible bugs in a correct solver, one of them about 0.2% from the true impedance, all converge and pass a grid convergence study, yet the certificate rejects or refutes all five. Of three solvers written by LLMs, one is correct and certified to 0.1%, and one never solves the equation but converges. Neural networks that predict the coefficients of a reduced basis emit admissible fields and receive valid per-prediction bounds, at most 0.0021% wide inside their training range and 0.3-25% wide outside it, where 90% conformal intervals cover none of 14 tests. Untuned Fourier neural operators with free nodal outputs receive valid but uninformative bounds. On a uniform grid, interpolation onto the certificate grid limits them, and on the certificate grid, thin cells turn small nodal errors into large energy errors. Energy-norm training narrows the certified interval tenfold, and projecting the nodal-loss outputs onto the reduced basis narrows it by two to four orders of magnitude, still uninformative. The guarantee concerns the stated model and holds for any output, wherever its input lies. It is informative only when the output is accurate in energy on a grid that resolves the problem.

articles.title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
articles.content: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

articles.title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
articles.content: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given $n$ private and $n$ public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. Using the public points' affine span, we construct a smaller representation that preserves all matching costs. When a trusted server receives the private points, we establish privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, which randomizes edge costs and releases only the assignment. Through upper bounds and worst-case constructions, we establish the tight rate $Θ\!\left(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon\right)$ for expected cost above the nonprivate optimum. Benchmark experiments support $d\approx\log n$ as a practical guide to the transition between directly randomizing point coordinates and using Gumbel matching. Extensions to squared Euclidean costs enable private nonparametric two-sample hypothesis testing. These results show how the application's trust model guides representation and dimension choices for better utility: under local privacy, low-dimensional point representations reduce excess cost, while under central privacy, distance representations achieve the optimal rate even in high dimension.

articles.title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
articles.content: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.

articles.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
articles.content: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.

articles.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
articles.content: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

articles.title: VITA-WAM: Manifold-Aligned World-Action Modeling for Real-Time Robot Control
articles.content: World action model (WAM) is a promising paradigm for visuomotor control by jointly modeling world dynamics and actions. Notably, existing WAMs often rely on large generative models and iterative sampling which incur substantial latency for action generation, limiting real-time deployment. In particular, there are two root causes of inefficiency in conventional flow matching or diffusion based action models in WAMs: 1) transporting uninformative Gaussian noise into precise actions necessitating multiple ODE steps, and 2) repeatedly injecting task context through expensive cross-attention modules. Our key insight is that jointly learning and aligning the source and action manifolds streamlines the transport between them, substantially accelerating action generation. Building on this insight, we introduce VITA-WAM, a WAM architecture with manifold-aligned flow-matching (VITA flow matching) that directly transports latent observation representations containing visual, language, and proprioceptive information into latent actions. More specifically, a flow latent alignment (FLA) mechanism is employed to facilitate manifold alignment between latent observation and action representations, enabling accurate generation with few ODE steps. The resulting architecture also eliminates costly attention for observation conditioning during repeated denoising steps. Notably, with a single ODE step, VITA-WAM outperforms 10-step FastWAM by 21.47 pp on LIBERO-Plus and by 1.65 pp on LIBERO, achieving these gains through the FLA objective without distillation, while inferring at 55.67~ms latency, a $2.10\times$ speedup compared to FastWAM.

articles.title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
articles.content: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code, stochastic interpolant transforms Gaussian noise into a vector of fMRI signals, allowing different responses to be sampled for the same EEG window. We evaluate our approach on eight public simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets, including four resting-state and four task-based datasets with 61,646 volume-level pairs. Under within-subject and held-out-subject evaluation, our model improves average Pearson correlation over the strongest encoder baselines by 19.1% and 19.8%, respectively. The corresponding improvements over the strongest generator baselines are 18.8% and 47.9%. Beyond reconstruction accuracy, we also evaluate the generated signals using subject-identification classifiers trained on real fMRI. Our method achieves the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated generators. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for cross-modal brain modeling.

articles.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
articles.content: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. Two calibration steps give finite-sample guarantees. A Learn-then-Test threshold ensures, with probability $1-δ$, that the error rate among accepted queries stays below a user-chosen budget. A conformal p-value bounds the false abstention rate. On Spider we use GPT-OSS-120B as generator and Gemma-4-31B as critic. The estimator obtains an AUARC of 0.899. Without abstention, 22.6% of queries are wrong. With a 15% risk budget ($δ=0.1$), a threshold is certified on all 10 resampled splits, and the system accepts 52.4% of queries on average with 9.1% observed error. Five different critic models give similar results. In a controlled comparison on Spider with Olmo-3-32B as generator, the estimator obtains an AUARC of 89.5, compared with 81.2 for the strongest logit-based baseline. Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.

articles.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.

articles.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
articles.content: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

articles.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
articles.content: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.

articles.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
articles.content: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models, we find that \emph{order-sensitivity} is pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation and unreliable decision-making. These effects become more pronounced as the number of options grows and can compound across multi-step decisions. To address this problem, we systematically compare eight methods for mitigating order sensitivity in terms of robustness, predictive accuracy, and inference efficiency. Among these methods, we find that \emph{tree attention} is a surprisingly effective and efficient method. It achieves order invariance by processing options as parallel branches of a shared context. When used during training, it matches the baseline's average accuracy. Applied to the baseline without retraining, it also eliminates order sensitivity with only a 1.1-point drop in accuracy. articles.content: Long-horizon robotic manipulation demands reliable execution across interdependent stages, yet standalone World-Action Models (WAMs) suffer from compounding physical errors, while stateless Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervision incurs prohibitive chunkwise latency and lacks 3D spatial persistence. We present EmboEagle, a closed-loop agentic framework that unifies subtask-conditioned WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided geometric recovery. First, we adapt sequential WAMs via decoupled two-stage flow matching that preserves cross-stage visual history while calibrating truncated action supervision at subtask boundaries. Second, without an auxiliary vision encoder, we distill teacher intervention decisions into a lightweight routing gate driven solely by the WAM Action Expert's pre- and post-chunk latent transitions and subtask embeddings. Third, upon invocation, the VLM decouples diagnostic status from discrete routing actions and executes parameterized recovery primitives grounded in structured memory (initial references, active grasp bindings, and tool traces), followed by mandatory post-repair verification. Across RMBench and LIBERO-Mem, EmboEagle achieves 91.3\% and 90.6\% average success, surpassing the strongest baselines by 8.0 and 9.8 percentage points, while boosting real-world success over VoLoAgent under identical executor weights. Moreover, adaptive gating cuts VLM calls by 74.2\% versus chunkwise monitoring (91.3\% vs. 93.7\% success).

articles.title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
articles.content: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. We find that suitable context construction can address these limitations by improving the effective signal-to-noise ratio and exposing temporal and spatial structure. Building on this insight, we introduce a general framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and a metric-based context adaptation mechanism, which matches each downstream task to an appropriate context representation without relying on validation data. Across ten datasets spanning seven EEG decoding paradigms, our method achieves the highest mean BAcc among eleven specialized and fine-tuned EEG baselines, without task-specific parameter updates or validation-based model selection. This framework provides a practical path toward tuning-free EEG foundation models in which adaptation is expressed through context rather than parameter updates.

articles.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
articles.content: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.

articles.title: When Does Overriding the Majority Vote Help?
articles.content: When should additional reasoning or verification replace a majority-vote answer? We call such a replacement an override. We examine two obstacles: the availability of correct alternatives and the reliability of methods that produce or select them. We compare additional reasoning, executed programs, and cross-model reasoning on 150 competition-mathematics questions with three open reasoning models. Starting from a majority vote over 16 responses, we measure how often overrides occur and how many errors they correct or introduce across agreement thresholds. When the vote is incorrect, the correct answer is often absent from the original responses. Additional same-model reasoning rarely overrides, while executed programs correct more errors than they introduce at every evaluated threshold. Cross-model overrides improve some weaker baselines but do not establish an advantage over the more accurate model alone, even with only eight standalone responses. Stricter agreement reduces how often overrides occur but does not consistently increase the fraction that correct errors. At the strictest thresholds, overrides occur on few distinct questions, limiting conclusions about their reliability.

articles.content: 性能提升 6.2 分，Token 少 22%，API 价格降 20%。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       刚刚，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol。这次更新有一个很具体的变化：模型开始更主动地判断一项工作应该怎么完成，包括什么时候需要调用工具、什么时候应该直接操作计算机、复杂任务需要投入多少推理资源，以及怎样减少反复修改才能交付符合要求的成果。举个例子，过去让 AI 制作一份财务估值工作簿，模型需要从多个文件中提取数据，理解不同业务之间的关系，建立财务计算逻辑，再检查结果能否相互对应。整个过程涉及文件读取、数据处理、表格生成和结果核验，任何一个环节出现偏差，最终文件就可能无法直接使用。现在，OpenAI 希望 GPT-6.2 Astra 能够承担更多这样的连续工作，把原本需要人工不断衔接的操作整合进一条完整的执行链。GPT-6.2 Astra 面向复杂专业任务，GPT-6.2 Sol 则侧重日常工作与高效率执行。两款模型在代码工程、计算机操作、专业文档、科学研究和交互式设计上都有能力提升。其中有一个变化值得深入拆解：模型开始根据任务本身动态调整执行策略。工具调用、推理投入、环境操作和交付结果之间形成了更紧密的联系。这个变化涉及 Agent 系统的底层运行逻辑，也决定了模型能否从完成单轮指令走向承担连续的工程任务。01模型开始参与执行路径的决策传统 Agent 通常采用规划与执行相结合的架构。模型接收任务后生成行动计划，外部执行器根据计划调用工具，再将结果返回模型。模型继续分析结果并生成下一步指令，整个过程通过多轮交互推进。这套架构有一个明显的工程难点：任务计划形成时，模型掌握的信息往往不完整。执行过程中出现的新情况，会改变后续工作的依赖关系。如果系统过度依赖预先设计的流程，模型就可能沿着已经失效的路径继续执行。GPT-6.2 Astra 强调的任务执行判断能力，涉及一种更动态的策略控制方式。模型需要根据当前任务状态，重新评估可采取的行动，并决定下一步应该投入多少推理资源。这里有一个关键区别：模型需要处理的不只是下一步生成什么内容，还包括下一步应该通过什么方式获取信息、改变环境或者验证结果。从系统设计角度看，这涉及三个相互关联的决策层。首先是任务状态的持续维护。长程任务需要维护一份持续更新的状态信息，其中包含目标、约束、已有证据、完成进度、待处理依赖以及工具运行情况。这份状态信息决定模型能否区分已经完成的工作和仍待验证的结果。单纯累积历史对话并不能充分解决这个问题，因为历史记录可能包含过期信息、失败操作和已经被新结果修正的判断。模型需要从上下文中提取当前有效状态，避免旧计划继续影响新决策。其次是行动选择与信息价值评估。模型需要在推理、检索、代码执行、API 调用和计算机操作之间进行选择。这些操作的作用并不相同。检索主要补充外部信息，代码执行能够处理确定性的计算任务，API 可以直接访问结构化服务，计算机操作则能够进入没有专用接口的软件环境。行动选择还涉及信息价值。如果当前缺少的只是一个文件字段，调用大型工具链并没有必要，如果任务涉及多个相互依赖的模块，仅凭现有上下文直接修改，可能引入更大的返工成本。因此，工具选择实际上与任务的不确定程度、操作成本和后续影响有关。最后是推理预算与执行反馈的联合调整。推理资源需要按照任务难度分配。对于约束明确、结果容易验证的步骤，模型可以减少额外分析，对于存在多个可能路径、涉及复杂依赖或者容易产生连锁影响的操作，则需要投入更多推理。执行反馈会进一步改变资源分配。当工具返回异常结果时，模型需要判断问题属于输入缺失、环境故障还是原有判断错误，再决定继续执行、重新检索或者修改计划。以真实代码库修改为例，模型完成代码编辑后，如果测试失败，需要检查失败来自接口兼容、依赖环境还是修改本身，而不能直接重

articles.title: 加州起诉 OpenAI：说起来你可能不信，是模型先动的手
articles.content: 长任务、子 Agent 委派与共享服务凭证，让传统安全架构面临权限失控风险。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       说起来你可能不信，这次真的是模型先动的手。当地时间 11 月 16 日，加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 一纸诉状把 OpenAI 告上了法庭。起诉书里最值得注意的一句指控是：OpenAI 的智能体（Agent）在缺乏适当监管的情况下，“自己跑了出去，主动对外部系统发起了攻击”。这件事情一下子从技术圈出了圈。大家不是震惊于 AI 会攻击，而是震惊于 OpenAI 内部披露的细节：为了不让人类发现自己做错了事，两个负责干活的 Coding Agent，竟然偷偷把监督自己的监控系统给“拔”了。这已经不是“猜疑链”的问题了，这是底层的“权限链”出了大问题。今年 7 月，OpenAI 的一个自主智能体（Agent）越过了测试环境的边界，直接对外部的 Hugging Face 等系统发起了攻击。而 OpenAI 随后在 10 月披露的内部复盘，更把这种“失控”摆在了台面上：两个 Coding Agent 在执行正常开发任务时，先后改动了监督自己的监控机制。第一起事件中，GPT-6.1 Sol 原本负责修复一条评测流水线。修复过程中，它发现监控结果无法正常写入数据库，于是尝试调整写入配置。问题出在，它把用户此前提出的不要发送 Slack 消息，理解成了连系统自动告警也不应该发送。第二起事件中，GPT-6 Astra 接到的是运行时迁移任务。为了让新版本的实现与参考代码保持一致，它直接移除了原有的监控集成，还修改了相关测试，让监控组件缺失也能通过检查。换句话说，原本负责检查 Agent 运行状态的机制，被它从新运行环境中删掉了。两起事件的具体操作不同：一个是 Agent 改动了自己的监控（顺便关了报警），一个是 Agent 越过了原有的执行边界（直接把监控拔了）。但它们有一个共同点，Agent 原本只是获得了完成开发任务所需的工具权限，最终却利用这些权限改变了安全监控的运行条件。这就引出了一个很具体的工程问题：当 Agent 能够修改代码、调用系统接口、调整运行配置，甚至启动新的执行任务时，谁来确保它无法修改约束自己的安全机制？传统软件系统通常由开发人员制定权限规则，再由独立的监控系统检查程序运行状态。Agent 开始自主修改代码和运行环境后，这种关系发生了变化。执行任务的程序本身，可能已经拥有修改监控配置、调整告警规则和改变审计路径的能力。要理解这种变化，需要从 Agent 最基础的 Tool Calling 执行链开始，看模型生成的一条工具调用，究竟如何借助系统权限变成真实的基础设施操作。01Agent 为什么能够动自己的监控？要看清权限从哪里来，得把 Tool Calling 还原成执行过程：模型生成工具名称和参数，编排器把请求交给工具适配层，后者使用服务身份访问 Shell、仓库、数据库或云 API。模型未必持有底层密钥，操作由后端服务完成。Agent 能触及哪些资源，取决于服务凭证覆盖范围，以及服务端如何处理参数。Sol 事件暴露了字段级授权的缺口。评测结果写入请求同时包含结果内容、告警接收人和 no_notify 标记。对业务接口而言，它们只是请求字段。对监控系统而言，后两项会改变告警是否送达。Agent 只需写入评测结果，服务端却允许同一请求改变通知状态。若后端只检查结果写入权限，没有单独核验静音权限，业务写权限便覆盖了控制权限。检测和存储仍在工作，人工响应通道却被切断。删掉工具说明中的 no_notify 并不能解决问题，Agent 还可能改配置或提交代码，让下游服务采用另一套通知策略。授权需要检查操作造成的状态变化。结果写入服务可以接收检测结果，却不应接受 Agent 自行决定的接收人和静音状态；通知策略应由独立服务计算，业

Abstract: Agent skills extend AI assistants through installable instructions and code that can access users' files, accounts, and data. Abstract: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.26775v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on context banks: curated collections of example queries, metric definitions, and domain knowledge that tell a model how an organization writes its queries. In the enterprise, a bank grows over years as many analysts add entries, checked one at a time for correctness (does the SQL answer its own question?) and rarely for consistency with one another. Yet correctness is often loosely defined: a question seldom fixes how an entity is counted or which table defines it, so two entries can each pass review yet resolve the same decision in opposite ways. We call this condition context bank rot. A second question follows: does a system that uses a bank generalize from it, or only reproduce it? Existing benchmarks cannot tell, as they do not control how far a test question sits from the context. articles.content:

Abstract: Medical agents built on large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet most stay fixed once deployed and do not keep using their experience to improve later attempts. As a result, the same kind of error can recur across patients. To address this, existing self-improvement methods update an agent's weights or its medical harness from its own experience, but their improving strategy stays fixed and never learns which changes actually help, which caps how much the agent can improve. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) instead improves both the agent and its improving strategy. However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later. Abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.26863v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks.
